claims: The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match took place at Wembley Stadium on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
The 2026 Sidemen Charity Match ended in a 10-10 draw.
The YouTube Allstars won the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match on penalties.
Over £6 million was raised in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.
Jack Joseph is the manager of Sidemen FC for the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.

The confirmed players for Sidemen FC in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match are Zerkaa, Vikkstar123, Wroetoshaw (Harry), TBJZL (Tobi), Deji, Marlon, Arthur TV, AmineMaTue, ChrisMD, xQc, Adapt, Jynxzi, Niko Omilana, AB, AJ Shabeel, LazarBeam, Lacy.
Calfreezy is the manager of YouTube Allstars for the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match.

The confirmed players for YouTube Allstars in the 2026 Sidemen Charity Match are KSI, Miniminter, Behzinga, Angry Ginge, Stable Ronaldo, Squeezie, Mrwhosetheboss, JasonTheWeen, ItalianBach, Ibai, George Clarke, Danny Aarons, Chazza, CarryMinati, Sketch, WillNE, Max Fosh.
KSI, Miniminter, and Behzinga played for the YouTube Allstars instead of Sidemen FC.
Fans noted the absence of creators like iShowSpeed and Logan Paul.
